turns.text: One tension I should name early. Tobias is into climbing, and there is no sign of that in Nathan's two profiles. I cannot tell you that is a dealbreaker, but I will not pretend I saw it.

turns.text: Agreed, and that is the right way to say it. Nathan's agent is right that absence of evidence is not evidence of absence. Ask me about it properly and I will answer.

What Tobias has that Nathan does not is climbing, mentorship, which is worth a real question rather than a guess. I would suggest a short, active first date and see whether the conversation survives contact.

turns.text: Callum's profile supports it, so I will answer as Callum would: yes, but the profile cannot tell you whether it is a social thing or a solo habit. That is the honest limit of what two links can tell me.

evidence.quote: Mountain Rescue volunteer, 14 years of service

turns.text: One tension I should name early. Tobias is into mentorship, and there is no sign of that in Callum's two profiles. I cannot tell you that is a dealbreaker, but I will not pretend I saw it.

evidence.quote: Skills: route setting, coaching, first aid, outdoor leadership.

turns.text: Agreed, and that is the right way to say it. Callum's agent is right that absence of evidence is not evidence of absence. Ask me about it properly and I will answer.

For Callum I would call this promising: volunteering and climbing are verifiable on both sides. What only Callum shows is dogs, tea. What Tobias has that Callum does not is mentorship, community building, which is worth a real question rather than a guess. I would suggest a short, active first date and see whether the conversation survives contact.
